author: MuzzBuzz
body:
Hi,

I was permanently banned a while ago for various offences.

I deeply regret my actions and would very greatly appreciate it if you could please un ban me as I would love to be able to enjoy Minecraft on this server with my friends.

Thanks and kind regards,
Keatoboy
